evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22 writes directly to SQLite with a fresh connection per call and no retry/backoff or explicit durability settings
impact: Transient database errors or lock contention can fail order creation immediately; duplicate order IDs also surface as uncaught insert failures
mitigation: Add repository-level exception handling, decide on retry policy, and document SQLite durability expectations including locking behavior

evidence: minisvc/audit.py:4-10 only builds an in-memory event dict; minisvc/storage/repo.py:11-15 creates no audit table
impact: No durable audit history exists for investigations, replay, or compliance despite the documentation claim
mitigation: Either persist audit records explicitly or remove durability claims from docs and API expectations

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-13 exposes Settings.readonly, but minisvc/cli.py:7-12 and minisvc/api/handlers.py:6-13 never enforce it
impact: Readonly deployments may still mutate production data because operators have a false sense of protection
mitigation: Enforce readonly in the write path and add a startup warning or failing fast when readonly is requested but unsupported

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:6-13 indexes payload keys directly and casts total_cents with int(...) without validation handling
impact: Malformed requests can raise KeyError or ValueError instead of returning stable client errors
mitigation: Add request validation and explicit error mapping before constructing Order

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:12 calls repo.save without catching sqlite3.IntegrityError or OperationalError
impact: Write-path exceptions can bubble to the HTTP framework and produce inconsistent or opaque failure responses
mitigation: Normalize repository exceptions into deterministic API errors and add tests for duplicate order IDs and database failures
